notablePrerequisites: Phantom Nishoba does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Phantom Nishoba persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Nishoba, adding {C}{C}.
When Phantom Nishoba dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.
